news.title: Guggenheim Upgrades SentinelOne
news.text: Guggenheim upgraded SentinelOne from Neutral to Buy with a $26 target, citing confidence in the company's AI-native cybersecurity platform and noting a brief 3.8% after-hours share gain.

news.title: SentinelOne's AI-Driven Positioning Highlighted
news.text: Barchart.com profiled SentinelOne's AI-focused strategy and argued the stock remained undervalued compared with cybersecurity peers despite recent share price declines.

news.title: SentinelOne to Acquire Prompt Security
news.text: SentinelOne announced plans to acquire Prompt Security in order to strengthen its GenAI and agent security capabilities.

news.title: SentinelOne Reports Q2 FY2026 Results
news.text: The company posted second-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue of $242.2 million, up 22%, and said annualized recurring revenue surpassed $1 billion.

news.title: Market Reaction to SentinelOne Earnings
news.text: Financial outlets reported that despite strong revenue growth, SentinelOne's larger-than-expected net loss triggered volatility in the share price following its earnings release.

news.title: SentinelOne to Acquire Observo AI
news.text: SentinelOne agreed to acquire Observo AI to expand its SIEM and security operations capabilities.

news.title: D.A. Davidson Raises SentinelOne Price Target
news.text: Following strong ARR performance, D.A. Davidson lifted its SentinelOne price target to $19 while reiterating a positive outlook.

news.title: SentinelOne Wins CISA Contract
news.text: SentinelOne secured a $2 million agreement with the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency to provide advanced endpoint protection for critical infrastructure.

news.title: SentinelOne to Showcase at GITEX GLOBAL
news.text: The company announced plans to present its AI-powered security operations platform at GITEX GLOBAL 2025 in Dubai.
